title: Guide the whole hook-up from /ia:init, and record an fnm shell's Node by a lasting path
summary: The Claude plugin's /ia:init skill is now the whole hook-up procedure, for a repository with no workspace and for an existing workspace not yet registered. It grounds with one CLI (the repository's pinned @inventarch/cli when it is installed) and ia doctor. It asks once whether to initialize, which hosts to register (Claude Code alone or with Codex) and, when doctor's source-protection row warns, whether to author a hook over .ia/src. It applies each host after its plan is confirmed. It then proposes a .gitignore block for the machine-local host files and edits to the user's own AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, and checks the result with ia doctor and ia validate. Every write is shown and confirmed first, and the skill never commits or pushes. Separately, a registration made under fnm no longer records the per-shell fnm_multishells Node, which fnm deletes once that shell is gone and which stopped the ia-workspace MCP server from starting: it records fnm's default alias when that alias reaches the same Node, and otherwise the installed version.
